name: Gulf Lamb Saloona with Vegetables

components.name: Lamb Saloona

ingredients.name: Medium carrots, cut into 5 mm cubes (~60 g each)
Beef bouillon cubes (or bezar spice equivalent)

steps: Chop lamb and vegetables into even chunks, with potato and carrot larger than the zucchini.
Sweat onion in oil until softened. Add lamb and brown thoroughly, then stir in garlic and ginger.
Stir in tomato paste and Gulf spices for about one minute.
Add stock or water and simmer the lamb covered until tender, roughly 45–70 minutes depending on the cut.
Add potato and carrot first; cook 10–15 minutes, then add zucchini and pepper for 10–15 minutes more.
Finish with chopped coriander and check seasoning.

components.name: Basmati Rice
